results.overview: In Havana, in a Wi-Fi park, four young people alienated from everyday life surf the virtual world through their profiles; but they will come into conflict with the reality that surrounds them and with the image they want to project to others.

results.title: Non scendo!
results.overview: Giulia lives with her mother in a house near the forest. On her 14th birthday, she discovers that the forest is in danger and decides to protect it by going to live in a tree.

results.overview: As Minister of Propaganda, Joseph Goebbels creates films and pictures used to prepare the Germans for Total War and the Holocaust. When the war is lost, he conceives his last staging, the most radical propaganda act still possible to him.

results.title: Elton John: Never Too Late
results.overview: Sir Elton John looks back on his life and the astonishing early days of his 50-year career in this emotionally charged, full-circle journey. As he prepares for his final concert in North America at Dodger Stadium, Elton takes us back in time and recounts his struggles with adversity, abuse, and addiction, and how he overcame them to become the icon he is today.

results.title: Female 4
results.overview: In a peaceful battery goli, where everyone took an oath not to fight amongst themselves, chaos ensues as another Female hops into the scene.

results.title: Doprovázení
results.overview: Kamila, a general practitioner on the verge of retirement, takes care of her parents - her 90-year-old dad and Alzheimer's-stricken mum. She accompanies them in the final stages of their lives. In doing so, she is aware of her own mortality and the fact that there is no one who will support her in the future to the same extent.

results.title: California Quail
results.overview: A film about a birdwatcher looking for the state bird of California and Arizona.

Tristes Tigres
results.overview: Marcos is a boy with dyslexia and dyslalia who is teased by his entire class because of the way he writes and speaks. One day, like any other, his classmate Alejandro will make him suffer the worst day of his life.

results.title: The Balconettes
results.overview: As a heat wave brings a Marseille neighborhood to a boil, three roommates gleefully meddle in the lives of their neighbors from their balcony. Until a late night drink turns into a bloody affair.

results.title: Calostro
results.overview: In the midst of a lamb's agony, two lovers play under a sheet. The sheet, which is both linen and a shroud, captures her death and immortalizes what it was.

results.title: A Volta
results.overview: Laura is surprised one night with the news that her younger sister Katherine, who disappeared at age 7, has been found. More than 11 years have passed since the tragic event. Her parents died uncertain whether their daughter was alive or not. Now, Laura must cope alone with this reunion and with all of Katherine's scars.

results.title: Tacoma
results.overview: Leo and Alejandra attempt to formulate a groundbreaking serum to help their loved ones while battling personal demons that threaten as well as drive their ambition.

results.title: Debtor’s Wife
results.overview: Soo-yeong and Hae-soo are college friends stuck in a love tangle: Soo-yeong likes Che-moo, but Che-moo likes Hae-soo. Meanwhile, Hae-soo likes Dae-in, but Dae-in likes Soo-yeong. Despite the mixed-up feelings, they end up in mismatched marriages. Later, Hae-soo wants to have a baby and tries to get closer to her husband, Dae-in. But Dae-in knows he can’t have children, so he secretly makes a surprising proposal to Soo-yeong’s husband, Che-moo.

results.title: He Sees You When You're Sleeping
results.original_title: He Sees You When You're Sleeping
results.overview: Chester returns to the home of his estranged and hideously over-privileged family at Christmas, only to find an unknown killer disguised in a Santa outfit is stalking and killing family members one by one, in order to claim the huge family fortune. Which one of them is the killer?

results.title: Hold Your Breath
results.overview: In 1930s Oklahoma amid the region's horrific dust storms, a woman is convinced that a sinister presence is threatening her family.
